security_audit.summary: The skill relies on the external eightctl CLI, which can control an Eight Sleep device after authentication. Markdown-only detections for config paths, homepage metadata, and rate-limit notes were false positives, but mutable installation, credential handling, and device-changing commands require clear safeguards.

remediation.issue: The installer references a mutable Go module version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the eightctl module to a reviewed release and document how users can verify the installed binary.

remediation.issue: The skill requires Eight Sleep account credentials through config or environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to protect the config file permissions and never paste credentials into chat transcripts.

remediation.issue: Commands can change temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, or base position.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation for every mutating command, not only temperature and alarms.

content.user_title: Control Eight Sleep Pods from AI Agents
content.value_statement: Managing an Eight Sleep pod can require manual app checks for status, temperature, alarms, and schedules. This skill lets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use eightctl to inspect and adjust supported pod controls.
actual_capabilities: Check Eight Sleep pod status through the eightctl CLI.
Turn the pod on or off after authentication.
Set pod temperature with eightctl temperature commands.
Control supported audio and base position commands.
limitations: Requires the external eightctl binary to be installed.
Requires Eight Sleep account authentication through config or environment variables.
Device-changing commands should be confirmed before execution.

use_cases.title: Check Bed Status
use_cases.description: Inspect pod status before bedtime without opening the mobile app.

use_cases.title: Adjust Sleep Settings
use_cases.description: Change temperature, alarms, or schedules through guided AI prompts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Home Routines
use_cases.description: Review bed controls while planning evening or morning automation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Use eightctl to check my Eight Sleep pod status and summarize the active settings.

prompt_templates.title: Set Temperature
prompt_templates.prompt: Set my Eight Sleep pod temperature to 20 after confirming the change with me.

prompt_templates.title: Review Alarms
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Eight Sleep alarms and identify any alarm that may affect tomorrow morning.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Routine Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my pod status, alarms, and schedules, then propose changes for a weekday sleep routine. Ask before applying changes.

output_examples.output: The pod is reachable. I found the current state, active temperature setting, and available control options.
I can change the pod temperature, but I will ask for confirmation before applying the new setting.
I found the configured alarms and can help create, dismiss, or adjust them after you confirm the target alarm.

best_practices: Confirm every command that changes pod state before running it.
Keep Eight Sleep credentials out of prompts, logs, and shared transcripts.
Avoid repeated login attempts because the API is unofficial and rate-limited.
anti_patterns: Do not run temperature, alarm, schedule, audio, or base changes without confirmation.
Do not paste Eight Sleep passwords into chat messages.
Do not automate frequent polling that may trigger rate limits.

faq.question: Does this skill install eightctl?
faq.answer: The metadata declares a Go-based eightctl install target. Users should verify the source and version before use.

faq.question: Does this skill need my Eight Sleep credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The eightctl tool requires authentication through its config file or supported environment variables.

faq.question: Can it change my pod temperature?
faq.answer: Yes. It can run eightctl temperature commands after the user confirms the requested setting.

faq.question: Can it manage alarms and schedules?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents alarm and schedule list, create, update, and dismiss workflows.

faq.question: Is the Eight Sleep API official?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that the API is unofficial and rate-limited.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
